title: A # inside a SQL block is SQL, not a LookML comment
rule: # starts a LookML comment outside SQL blocks; inside a SQL block it is part of the SQL.

citations.quote: To add a single comment, use the # character:
If you are commenting out lines that are entirely within a SQL code block, manually add SQL comment notation.

rationale: Commenting out SQL requires SQL comment notation because # inside a SQL block is passed to the database as SQL.
